title: The schema depicts a nonphysical possession of things

statements.text: Lacking mechanism, the schema depicts something physically incoherent: a mental possession or experience of an item that empowers one to act on it, vague in location, without tangible attributes, and yet potent. A brain that reports from it says it has an ethereal awareness.

sources.quote: Instead, the attention schema would depict something physically incoherent, a process without a physical manifestation
Attention has no highly precise location. It is vaguely inside the head.
